title: C20 gibberellins: oxidise, then contract ring B.
C20 gibberellin: 산화 뒤 ring B 축소.
intro: Connect ent-CPP and ent-kaurene to six plant KO/KAO stages ending at GA12.
ent-CPP와 ent-kaurene을 GA12까지 이어지는 식물 KO/KAO의 여섯 단계와 연결합니다.

edges.label: ent-CPS · TPS II
edges.detail: Produces ent-CPP, a substrate for ent-kaurene synthases.

edges.label: AtKS / SrKS · TPS I
edges.detail: ent-Kaurene synthases ionize ent-CPP and form a tetracyclic C20 skeleton. This is a specific precursor–enzyme match.

edges.label: AtKO1 / CYP701A3 · oxidation
edges.detail: First C19 oxidation in the characterised plant KO sequence.
edges.detailKo: 규명된 식물 KO 경로의 첫 번째 C19 산화입니다.

edges.label: AtKO1 / CYP701A3 · oxidation
edges.detail: KO oxidises the alcohol intermediate to the aldehyde. This is a net biochemical stage, not an elementary single-electron mechanism.
edges.detailKo: KO는 alcohol 중간체를 aldehyde로 산화합니다. 순생화학 단계이며 한 번의 전자 이동을 뜻하지 않습니다.

edges.label: AtKO1 / CYP701A3 · oxidation
edges.detail: Further KO-catalysed oxidation produces ent-kaurenoic acid.
edges.detailKo: KO가 추가 산화하여 ent-kaurenoic acid를 형성합니다.

edges.label: AtKAO1/2 · hydroxylation
edges.detail: First stage of the characterised plant CYP88A/KAO sequence.
edges.detailKo: 규명된 식물 CYP88A/KAO 경로의 첫 번째 단계입니다.

edges.label: AtKAO1/2 · ring-B contraction
edges.detail: The second KAO stage contracts ring B and generates the gibbane skeleton. The detailed rearrangement is distinct from the earlier class II labdane/halimane/clerodane cascade.
edges.detailKo: KAO의 두 번째 단계는 ring B를 축소하여 gibbane 골격을 만듭니다. 앞선 class II labdane/halimane/clerodane 재배열과는 별개입니다.

edges.label: AtKAO1/2 · aldehyde oxidation
edges.detail: The third KAO stage oxidises the remaining aldehyde to a carboxylic acid.
edges.detailKo: KAO의 세 번째 단계는 남은 aldehyde를 carboxylic acid로 산화합니다.
